title.text: Outside London, regions gaining people churn no more than those losing them
subtitle: ITL2 regions outside London, 2018–24 (job reallocation and migration both pooled). Longer-distance moves only (between English regions and nations). Correlation -0.29. Grey line = fit.
Dotted line = average job reallocation outside London (26.7%). Net figures exclude international migration.
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS and National Records of Scotland internal migration; ONS, NRS and NISRA population estimates; authors' calculations.
